output.summary: The district is paying WCNSM Enterprises, LLC (doing business as Protect|Education) $912,087.23 for air purifiers, a report on indoor air quality and student attendance, and sales tax, at five school sites. The work starts December 12, 2024 and continues until it is finished or the agreement ends. The official text does not name the five sites.

output.headline: Approves Oakland Tech's trip for 34 students to Basketball Showdown in Minneapolis at no district cost
output.summary: The Board is approving a resolution allowing Oakland Technical High School to take 34 students in grades 10 and 12 to the Basketball Showdown in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The trip ran December 4 through December 8, 2024, which is before the Board vote, and costs the district nothing.

output.headline: Approves 2023-24 Measure G1 carryover funding requests for named schools
output.summary: The Board is adopting a resolution that approves requests from named schools to carry over unspent 2023-2024 Measure G1 money. The G1 oversight commission, which reviews teacher retention and middle school improvement funding, recommended it. The text does not state a dollar amount or list the schools.

output.headline: Creates a Paraeducator, Young Adult Services job and revises two other paraeducator job descriptions
output.summary: The board is creating a new job description, Paraeducator, Young Adult Services, and revising the job description for Paraeducator, Special Education and Transitional Kindergarten. They take effect at 12:01 a.m. on December 12, 2024 on the respective salary schedule or range. The official text gives no dollar amounts.
